national.title: Jejak Pendidikan Amran dan Sugiono, 2 Cawapres Usulan Prabowo
national.summary: Presiden Prabowo Subianto serahkan dua nama cawapres ke MPR: Andi Amran Sulaiman dan Sugiono. MPR akan verifikasi sebelum pemilihan pada 11 Desember.

international.title: South Korea tells island residents to take shelter after Russian military aircraft approach
international.summary: The order was issued after aircraft entered the country’s air defence identification zone over the island of Ulleungdo Residents of a remote South Korean island were ordered to take shelter on Tuesday morning after several Russian military aircraft came close to entering its airspace, prompting a pre-emptive alert from the military that anticipated a violation. The defence ministry said it would summon the Russian defence attaché on Tuesday afternoon to lodge a strong protest. Continue reading...

international.title: Mexico to try ‘El Chapo Isidro’ despite US extradition request
international.summary: Fausto Meza Flores faces drug trafficking and weapons charges after his capture in a violent Sinaloa operation.

international.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
international.summary: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.
